related_questions.question: How do I Login to eFiling?
related_questions.snippet: a) Log on to the SARS website. On the top right side of the home page select <Login> from the list of eFiling options. i) Enter your eFiling Username and click on <Next> ii) Enter your Password and click on <Login>. iii) The eFiling welcome screen will display.

related_questions.question: How do I Login to the Indian income tax portal?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: Go to the e-Filing Portal homepage and click Login. Step 2: Enter your PAN in the Enter your User ID textbox and click Continue. Step 3: Confirm your Secure Access Message. Enter your password and click Continue.
related_questions.title: Login User Manual | Income Tax Department

related_questions.question: How can I check my PAN and Aadhaar link status?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: On the e-Filing Portal homepage, under Quick Links, click Link Aadhaar Status. Step 2: Enter your PAN and Aadhaar Number, and click View Link Aadhaar Status. On successful validation, a message will be displayed regarding your Link Aadhaar Status.
